title: feat(app-shell,plugin-list): a page list-view node's addRecord opens the object list's create; publish list-view.addRecord
body:
Fixes #13089
Clause-②: yes

## What this changes

A page `list-view` node's `addRecord` Add button now opens the create form that the object list opens. `list-view.addRecord` is published. The console's object list no longer draws a dead Add button.

1. **Page host** (`pageRecordActions.ts` `pageRelatedHandlers`). Under the seat ruling on the card (Q1 = A), the input's shape decides what is served.
   - An **object-scoped list** has no `relationshipField` (absent or empty) and no `parentId`. This is a page `list-view` node, which resolves `{ objectName }`. It is served the bridge's create pair, `onCreate` / `createDisabled`, and nothing else.
   - A **related list whose parent did not resolve** names its `relationshipField`. It is still served nothing, so it draws no "+ New". That button would have opened a child form linked to no parent.
   - **Under a parent**, the served set is unchanged: the objectui#12870 executors.
2. **Contract** (`@object-ui/react`, `ResolveRelatedRecordActionsInput` docblock only, no type or member change). The docblock says what an input without `relationshipField` asks for. The spec's `record:related_list` requires `relationshipField`, so a spec-valid related list always names one. The docblock also names the limit of this reading: a future consumer that must not create needs an explicit member.
3. **`editMode: 'page'`** (ruling 6). `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` `openChildForm` gets one branch. A create linked to no parent now goes to `resolveRecordFormTarget`, the resolver `AppContent`'s `handleEdit` uses. For an `editMode: 'page'` object it navigates to the full-page create route, as the object list does; otherwise it opens the overlay as before.
4. **Console object list** (item 2, `ObjectView.tsx` `renderListView`). It forwarded `addRecord` and no `onAddRecord`. The Add button now calls the header New's create (`actions.create`, which is `onEdit(null)`). It is offered only where the New is offered and not greyed: `objectCanCreate && createVisible && !createDisabled`.
5. **Publishing** (`plugin-list`). `addRecord` joins `LIST_VIEW_INPUTS` (shared by `list-view` and `list`). Its description says what is read: `enabled` and `position`; `mode` and `formView` are not read. It also says what the click opens. The `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS` row is struck and a `MEMBER_PINS` entry points at the real-`PageView` pin. The README, the mdx and the stale docblocks are updated.

6. **Changeset** (`.changeset/13089-page-list-create.md`): `@object-ui/plugin-list` `minor` (a published registry input, as objectui#13074 did), `@object-ui/app-shell` `minor` (a page-host capability and a new create route), `@object-ui/react` `patch` (docblock only). These levels were set in the patch round `3b8fab4ff1` after the contract review.

## Measured before changing (each leg is a run, not a reading)

- **The seat's fork (Q1).** I ran the 12870 harness plus an unbound `record:related_list` probe. When the create pair was served to every parent-less resolve, the probe drew `related-list-new` (4/4 green). On `origin/main` the same probe was red: 1 failed, 3 passed.
- **Item 2.** `ObjectView.addRecordOpensCreate-13089.test.tsx` ran on the base before the fix: `Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3)`.
  - The Add button drew, and its click called `onEdit` 0 times.
  - For a viewer with no create grant, the header New was hidden and the Add button was still drawn.
  - After the fix: `Tests 3 passed (3)`.
- **Ruling 6.** In the new PageView pin, the `editMode: 'page'` case stayed at `/apps/cloud/page/team` (overlay params) before the `openChildForm` branch: `expected '/apps/cloud/page/team' to be '/apps/cloud/sys_contract/new'`. It is green after the branch.

## Pins

`packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.listViewAddRecord-13089.test.tsx` runs through the real `PageView`, the real console action runtime, and the `plugin-list` and `plugin-detail` registrations.

- (a) An Add click pushes `form=new` and `formObject=sys_member`, with no `formLink`. An `editMode: 'page'` object navigates to `/apps/cloud/sys_contract/new`.
- (b) No create grant withholds the button, and so does a `createDisabled` create (`userActions.create.disabledWhen`).
- (c) CONTROLS:
  - A node without `addRecord` draws no button.
  - An unbound related list on the same page draws no "+ New" while the `list-view` beside it is served.
  - A probe block on the page reads the served set per input shape. Object-scoped (and empty `relationshipField`) gets `onCreate` only: no Edit, Delete, row click, "View all" or executor. An unbound related list gets nothing. Bound gets `onRowAction,onToolbarAction`.
  - The objectui#12870 CONTROL row stays as it is, because it covers a bound list.
- (d) The registration publishes `addRecord`. The parity row is struck and the member pin is green.
- (e) `ObjectView.addRecordOpensCreate-13089.test.tsx`: the Add button and the header New make the same `onEdit(null)` call. Without a create grant there is no Add button. A view without `addRecord` draws no Add button.

Rewritten to the new fact:
- The objectui#11293 navigator pin asserted that `resolve({ objectName })` equals `{}` on a page. It now asserts nothing for a related-list input and `onCreate` alone for an object-scoped one.
- The objectui#13074 registration row now expects `addRecord` to be published.

## Ablations

Each ablation used `ablation-replace.mjs`. Each mutation was proven on disk (anchor x1 to x0), and each restore was proven by blob hash: `47fc21a275c6` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

1. Remove the parent-less `onCreate` serving (`if (!onCreate)` becomes always return). Result: 4 failed, 6 passed. Red: (a), the `editMode` case, the unbound-related-list control (the `list-view` beside it is no longer served) and the served-set control.
2. Serve every handler parent-less (`return related.resolve(input)`). Result: 1 failed, the served-set control. It received `onCreate,onDelete,onEdit,onRowAction,onToolbarAction,onView,rowActions,toolbarActions`.
3. The seat's ablation: drop the `relationshipField` condition. Result: 2 failed. The unbound related list draws "+ New", and the probe's unbound-related row reads `onCreate`.

## Gates

Final head `1fbb3d66ac`, base `cd4623d063`. Exit codes were recorded to files.

- **Type-check.** I built the closure (`pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`), then ran `type-check` for `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/app-shell`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
  - `apps/console` (test file only): NOT MEASURED. Its `tsc --noEmit` cannot resolve `@object-ui/app-shell` and plugins whose dist this worktree did not build. That is a prerequisite failure, not a type verdict. Declared to CI.
- **Targeted vitest** (`--maxWorkers=1`, under the shared lock), on this head's test content:
  - 24 files, the `PageView.*` and `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.*` families plus readers of the touched files: 148 passed and 1 failed. The failure was the 11293 row, rewritten above, then 6/6 passed.
  - 72 `ObjectView*` files: 633/633.
  - 15 files: the console parity gate, the plugin-list `addRecord` readers, and the plugin-detail, plugin-form and components readers of the bridge: 445 passed and 1 failed. The failure was the 13074 registration row, rewritten above, then 15/15 passed.
  - Whole package directories (`app-shell`, `plugin-list`, `react`, `apps/console`) are declared to CI.
- **`pnpm lint`, narrowed** to the 12 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files with `eslint --no-inline-config --format json`: 0 errors. The 203 warnings are almost all on pre-existing lines of `ObjectView.tsx`/`RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx`. One new `no-explicit-any` warning is on the `objects.find((o: any)` lookup in `openChildForm`, the pattern the file already uses.
- **Pre-tsc battery:** all exit 0 (`check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `new-line-citations`, plus `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-fixed` and `check-changeset-presence`). `check:spec-floors` exits 1, as on main; recorded, not fixed.

## Acceptance notes

- **The `openChildForm` branch keys on "create with no link"**, so it also covers a record page's related list whose parent link value is still null (its `onCreate` already sends no `formLink`). For an `editMode: 'page'` object that create now goes to the full-page route and not the overlay. It is the same object-level create either way.
- **A create predicate parent-less.** On a page, the bridge evaluates `userActions.create.visibleWhen` / `disabledWhen` against no parent record, as the object list evaluates them against `null`. A predicate that reads `record.*` fails closed for `visibleWhen`, so the Add button is withheld. Observation only.
- **Spec defaults vs. the renderer: filed objectui#13099.** The spec's `AddRecordConfig` declares `enabled` default `true` and `position` default `'bottom'`. `ListView` draws the button only for an explicit `enabled: true` and places an absent `position` at the top. The contract review measured that neither the write door nor the client materialises the nested defaults. The published description, README and mdx now name the declared defaults and the divergence, and cite objectui#13099, which carries the enforce-or-remove decision. The renderer is unchanged here.

## Writes

Branch pushes, this draft PR (with the card's assignee), and one `os-dev-report` comment on the card. No labels: no objectui gate reads one, and the dispatch named none.
